offering_description.value: Operates an online automotive marketplace where consumers search for new and used vehicles and research cars. Sells listing subscriptions, advertising and digital retail and marketing tools to car dealerships and automakers.

primary_products.value: online vehicle listings marketplace; dealer software and digital retail tools; advertising products

primary_services.value: dealer digital marketing; lead generation; vehicle advertising; dealer website and inventory services

customer_segment.value: B2B: franchise and independent car dealerships, dealer groups, automakers and advertisers; B2C: car shoppers and vehicle sellers using the site free of charge

end_markets.value: automotive retail; automotive manufacturing; vehicle advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly dealer subscriptions for listings, marketing and software products; advertising: display and conquesting advertising from automakers and other advertisers; service fees: digital marketing and lead services for dealers

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates online marketplace connecting car shoppers with dealer inventory, paid by dealers and automakers; service provider: provides digital marketing and advertising services to dealers and manufacturers

geography_served.value: US national: Dealers and shoppers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: vehicle listings marketplace, dealer software, digital marketing and automaker advertising

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling subscriptions and advertising to dealers and automakers; online: cars.com website and mobile apps for consumers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general advertising, consumer data privacy and consumer protection rules such as FTC and state privacy laws
